title: UniGlobal Southern Europe Tax Summit
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
Vertex will be participating in the Southern Europe Tax Summit, bringing together tax, finance, and compliance leaders to explore the trends, challenges, and opportunities shaping the future of tax across the region.


As regulatory requirements continue to evolve, organizations are navigating an increasingly complex landscape of e-invoicing mandates, digital reporting obligations, and cross-border compliance requirements. The Southern Europe Tax Summit provides a valuable opportunity for tax professionals to exchange insights, share experiences, and discuss practical approaches to managing change.


Attendees will have the opportunity to connect with Vertex experts to discuss how leading organizations are modernizing tax operations, improving compliance processes, and leveraging technology to support broader business transformation initiatives.


From indirect tax and e-invoicing to data management and automation, the event will explore strategies for building a more agile and future-ready tax function. Whether you're evaluating your tax technology roadmap, preparing for new compliance requirements, or looking to optimize your global tax processes, we invite you to connect with Vertex at the Southern Europe Tax Summit.


For more information, please visit:[Southern Europe Tax Summit](https://loop.usercontent.microsoft/?preview=true)
